column1: # The (gate-name -> anchor-number) binding for the CM-COVENANT-114-<N>-PROPAGATION
# gate family. ONE row per gate. The engine
# (lib/covenant_propagation_engine.sh) is the single code copy; each
# gate NAME (required so the §11.4.227(A) gate ledger's structural
# `grep --include='*.sh'` instrument can see a real executable gate site) and
# looks its anchor up HERE. No role-specific value is duplicated in code.
# Lines beginning with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# Anchors CONFIRMED individually by T029 BEFORE their rows landed: each was run
# through this very engine against a scratch one-row data pack over the full
# 150-carrier fleet, and each returned rc=0 with 0 MISSING/DUPLICATED and
# HONEST GAP (§11.4.6 / §11.4.135): six further wrappers exist without rows —
# 162, 167, 176, 187, 201, 232 — and are DELIBERATELY NOT registered here.
# T029 measured each as a REAL §11.4.227(B) defect in the live corpus
# (201: F7-class DUPLICATION, 2 block-starts in all four constitution/ carriers;
# 162/167/176/187/232: §11.4.157 lockstep DIVERGENCE). Proven real, not an
# engine false-positive, by a control comparison against passing anchor 233
# whose constitution/ and parent blocks hash identically. Registering them
# would turn the wired pre-build suite RED; the divergences are governance
# CONTENT defects requiring their own remediation.
